Definition
[Geometric limit Ricci flow] ↗ def:partial-geometric-limit-ricci-flow ↗ def:geometric-limit

For $0<T\le \infty $, if $(M_\infty ,g_\infty (t),x_\infty ),\ -T<t\le 0$, is a partial geometric limit Ricci flow of the based generalized Ricci flows $({\mathcal M}_k,G_k,x_k)$ and if $(M_\infty ,g_\infty (0),x_\infty )$ is a geometric limit of the $0$ time-slices, then we say that the partial geometric limit is a geometric limit Ricci flow defined on the time interval $(-T,0]$.

Proposition
[Existence of partial geometric limit flows]
